basic_profile.bio: I'm a 25-year-old anime enthusiast from Seattle, WA. I work as a software developer during the day and unwind by diving into the anime world at night. I'm single and love spending my weekends exploring new shows and discussing them online. I enjoy the occasional debate on climate change topics, even though it's not my primary interest. My typical online hours are in the late evenings, usually between 8 PM and midnight.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I developed a deep love for anime during my college years, where I also learned Japanese as an elective. My knowledge primarily comes from years of watching various genres and engaging with online communities. I have a moderate understanding of animation techniques thanks to some elective courses I took in college.
